literal: Inclusive 200..219 main-feed posts, quotes and reposts; special main-feed replies count, other replies/community reposts excluded; captured deletions count. Oct16 noon ET to Oct23 noon ET. Tracker primary, X fallback only if incorrect. API end one second before literal end; boundary/reclassification risk retained.

branches.label: Friday profile persists, with future intensity uncertainty
branches.construction: Equal seven nonoverlapping completed Friday templates. Expected future=(current+.5)*historic_suffix/historic_prefix, linearly interpolated bins54..55 at current elapsed. Jeffreys .5 count correction; NB shape8 allows ~35% latent-intensity CV in addition to profile variation. Shape is judgement, not fitted.

branches.label: Calendar profile breaks
branches.construction: Constant hourly current rate; much wider future intensity CV~71%. Includes slowdown/acceleration risk, not an extrapolation of rounded tracker pace.

branches.label: Counter or resolution-source repair
branches.construction: Uniform terminal integer0..500, judgemental broad repair tail. Not a capture validation or empirical outage rate.

limits: Seven dependent behavioural weeks, not calibrated independent trials. Current prefix95 exceeds historical prefix max78; extrapolation may fail. Bin55 partly observed and historical within-hour arrivals nonuniform. API collection cutoff/qualifying post types not independently proved; old lastSync conflicts with newer records. Rounded API percent43/pace222 rejected: 54.52/168=32.45%. Range is subjective and wider than model sensitivities; no probability mass borrowed from case258 quiet total90 or case101 near-terminal tail. Dated valuation, not execution authorization.
